description:
Salt & Straw Peppermint Cocoa is a great flavour but I wanted to mix it up with a homemade Peppermint core that stay semi liquid even in the freezer!

As the Salt & Straw base is not mine, you can find the recipe in the video or in their books, the peppermint core though:

Ingredients:
Sweetened condensed milk 120g
Powdered sugar 100g
Water 15g
Peppermint extract 5-10g
Pinch of fine salt ~0.3 g
